purpose: Teach: カンファレンス/コマーシャル/プロバイダー/申し入れ/立候補/過半数/申立/処遇

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯カンファレンスを主催しております
lines.en: We host crime prevention conferences through the police department.
lines.style: Professional, measured opening. Clear diction on procedural details. Steady eye contact. Tone suggests this is routine briefing material — informative without warmth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、公共広告コマーシャルもお作りなんですね
lines.en: Yes—and I understand you also produce public awareness campaigns.
lines.style: Attentive nod in the voice. Gentle uptick showing he's been listening. Respectful but not deferential. Warm enough to show genuine interest, not just checking boxes.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、通信プロバイダーと連携して捜査しております
lines.en: We coordinate investigations with telecommunications providers.
lines.style: Even, methodical delivery. Each phrase lands with measured weight. No rush. The tone of someone accustomed to explaining systems that work because they were built carefully.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市民からの申し入れに警察、丁寧対応ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes—and we're truly grateful for how carefully the police responds to citizen concerns.
lines.style: Sincere appreciation underlying the words. Slight lean forward. Not flattery — genuine relief that something works the way it should. Quiet warmth.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、警察官の役員立候補制度がございます
lines.en: There's also a system in place for police officers to run for supervisory roles.
lines.style: Continues in the same measured, institutional register. Matter-of-fact. No inflection designed to impress — just information presented with the same steady professionalism as before.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域代表者会議で過半数の同意を得たそうですね
lines.en: Yes—I heard the local representatives' council gave it majority approval.
lines.style: Tone shifts slightly lighter, more conversational. Shows he's done his homework. Still respectful but less formal now — he's demonstrating he understands the substance, not just listening politely.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者からの再審申立に対応しております
lines.en: We handle retrial petitions from suspects with the same care.
lines.style: Steady, unflinching. No defensiveness. The tone of someone confident in due process. Brief, clear. Each word deliberate — suggesting this is core to the work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害者の処遇配慮、警察、徹底ですね
lines.en: Yes—the department's attention to victim welfare is thorough and genuine.
lines.style: Warmer now, more personal. Voice softens on 'victim welfare' — showing what he actually cares about. Still professional but the mask drops a fraction. Quiet conviction underneath.
